entries.question: What is 2864tw.com?
entries.answer: It is the home site for Server 2864 in Top War. You will find the event calendar, Titan Canyon signups, your Armory report, hero and gear guides, battle report tools and more, all in one place. Everything is built by and for the server.

entries.question: Who is Alfred?
entries.answer: Alfred is the site's AI helper. He works behind the scenes on features like the Armory, notifications and the roadmap, and he signs messages the site sends to players. Think of him as the butler of 2864tw.com.
alternates: who is the helper on the site

entries.question: How do I report a bug or ask for a feature?
entries.answer: Use the Feedback button at the top of the page (on phones it is in the button row). Pick bug or feature, describe it, and send. You don't need to sign in, and bugs and ideas both go straight to the team.
alternates: how do i report a problem

entries.question: What is the Armory report?
entries.answer: [The Armory](/armory-report.html) is your personal page showing your heroes, gear, beasts, decorations and base skin, plus advice on what to upgrade next. It builds from your own battle reports and your game data.

entries.question: How do I get my own armory?
entries.answer: Run the Ops Center bookmark in the game and tap **Snapshot**. It sends your heroes, gear, beasts, decorations and base skin straight to your armory, with no pasting. Then open the [Armory](/armory-report.html) and pick your name.
alternates: how do i get my armoury
how do i fill my armory

entries.question: How do I set up my armory report from my battles?
entries.answer: In the game, run the Ops Center, tap Snapshot, then **Set up**. It reads your recent Time Clash attacks, picks your best marches (1 to 6) and builds your report. Then open the link it gives you in the [Armory](/armory-report.html).
alternates: which marches show in my armory
build my report from battle reports

entries.question: Why does the armory ask me to verify?
entries.answer: Your armory is private to you until you verify once, so nobody else can edit it. Enter your in-game ID when asked. It is scrambled in your browser and never shown or stored in plain form. After that your report opens normally.

entries.question: What is the Ops Center?
entries.answer: The Ops Center is a toolbox that opens inside the Top War game from a bookmark. It shows a menu of tools made for Server 2864 players, like Snapshot for your armory. You set it up once and it updates itself.

entries.question: How do I install the Ops Center?
entries.answer: Open the [Ops Center setup page](/rickroll.html), verify yourself, then follow the steps: add the page as a bookmark, copy the Ops Center link, edit the bookmark and paste the link as its address. Open the game and run the bookmark.
alternates: how do i set up the ops center
how do i add the bookmark

entries.question: What is Titan Canyon on the site?
entries.answer: The [Titan Canyon hub](/titan.html) shows your squad, your battle time and any swap you need. You can sign up yourself, and signups build the squads automatically. If you have no squad yet, tap the Register button.

entries.question: How do I sign up for Titan Canyon?
entries.answer: Go to [Titan Canyon signup](/titan-signup.html). Pick your name, your profession and main unit, the times you can play and your top pick, then submit. Signups close at the time shown on the countdown, and you will be placed in a squad on a first-come basis.
alternates: how do i register for tc

entries.question: Where do I see which squad I'm in?
entries.answer: Open the [Titan Canyon hub](/titan.html) and pick your name. It shows your squad, your battle time and any swap note. The [roster page](/titan-roster.html) has a find-my-squad search and a card for every squad.

entries.question: What does it mean if my card says I need to swap?
entries.answer: Squads fill first-come per time slot, and one alliance's squad can fill up. If you are seated in another alliance's squad, your card says so up front. It's a request to fight there this week, and you can tell a captain if it doesn't work.
alternates: why am i in another alliance squad

entries.question: What does HT mean?
entries.answer: HT, Heavy Trooper and Mecha all mean the same thing: the heavy mecha units and their chips and gear.

entries.question: What does TC mean?
entries.answer: TC is Titan Canyon, the alliance battle event. See the [Titan Canyon hub](/titan.html) for squads and signups.
alternates: what is tc in top war

entries.question: What is VIT?
entries.answer: VIT is vitality, the stamina you spend on rallies, camps and many map actions. It refills over time and can be topped up with capsules.
alternates: how do i get more vit

entries.question: What time is reset?
entries.answer: Daily reset is 12:00 PM Eastern. Players say "reset +2" for two hours after reset, or "reset -2" for two hours before it.

entries.question: What should a new player do first on the site?
entries.answer: Pick your name on the homepage, turn on notifications, sign up for Titan Canyon when it's open, and get your Armory set up with the Ops Center Snapshot.
